items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 99:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the AB of Yodin? The Mochin of Chaya, fit for birth, are called the AB of Yodin, namely Havayah in the filling of Yuds. (Item 104).
